name: Silverpoint
description: Silverpoint: a line so fine it barely marks the ground, laid in parallel.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path*4 { d: M0 130 L130 0; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 3; transform: translate(calc(@n(-1) * 34 - 68) 0) }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path*4 { d: M0 130 L130 0; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 3; transform: translate(calc(@n(-1) * 34 - 68) 0) }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
